name: After § 6
title: 2025 general budget: all sections
part_text: 6 a. Calls for limiting GNI-based own contributions to 1% of GNI which would effectively mean a return to the level of Member State contributions before Brexit; underlines that expenditure should be cut accordingly to match own resources, focussing on the funds dedicated to the Green Deal, defence spending, and the Union's foreign policy.
